groups.label: Services
groups.accountOperations: GitHub lists personal accounts, installations and organizations in host order. Refresh/disconnect use the encoded account login; personal disconnect confirms disconnect_also. Adding uses the existing GitHub manifest/install callbacks. Older hosts without the accounts route retain the legacy shared flow.

groups.label: API keys
groups.keyOperations: API keys by provider, entered once (2026-11-18). Save checks the key first and keeps it only when the provider accepts it; Forget removes the saved key; a plugin that declared the provider can be given its own key and put back on the shared one. No route answers a whole value.
